snapshot.inputs: All tracked implementation source, prompts, templates and schemas; package and lockfiles; main/renderer/library/test/lint/format configuration; packaged README and SDK metadata; coverage and archive plans; imported contracts and exact dependencies; all installed dependency bytes including compiler/native tools; verification harnesses and Node executable. Build override variables and renderer .env inputs were absent.

testCoordinationInput.role: Uncommitted coordination manifest read only to validate task IDs; excluded from production source cleanliness claim

snapshot.exclusions: Existing planning amendments, checklist/coordination receipts, SlopTimize state and graph output are not application/build inputs. program.json is explicitly hashed as an uncommitted test coordination input. The full checkout and full test input set are not claimed committed. No private sibling implementation is loaded.

builds.scope: Runtime library, Electron main/shared/preload and renderer compiled locally. Desktop archive contains compiled inputs with external Electron/Node/native dependencies, not an installable native app. No GUI session was qualified.

archiveValidation.scope: SHA-256/SHA-512, sidecars, manifests, member sets, safe paths and every payload hash verified before extraction. Every relative import of the desktop agent command (main/agents/agent-config-writes), the approved-choice validator (shared/maestro-lib/managed/agent-policy) and the governed-field merge (shared/sessionPersistenceMerge) was redirected to the compiled desktop archive, and every import of the agent repository (maestro-lib/agents/repository, authorizeAgentMutation hook) to the public runtime bundle; four suites (host command and repository hook, sessions:commitAgent and whole-record persistence handlers, native create/edit/persistence races, governed-field merge) ran on those bytes, the persistence handlers loading the compiled command. agent-config-writes.test.ts and agents.locks.test.ts were tried and stay source-only: they install the settings write authority on the source settings-policy instance, which the compiled command does not share (5 failures of that kind, not of the subject). Renderer form, hook and dialog suites stay source-only. Public declaration checks and a plain Node load of the runtime repository (approved create committed, unapproved create refused before the write, throwing authority fails closed) passed. Temporary identity-only pin leaves the historical runtime pin unchanged.

tests.boundary: Local typed-port and public-schema fixtures, a contract-fixture endpoint double, temporary data directories and recording sinks only. No signed production delivery, real tenant, provider, native peer or live endpoint supplied authority. The e2e journeys (e2e/managed-agents.spec.ts) are not run here; MCOMP-24 executes and records them.

behavior: One host command (authorizeManagedAgentCommand over checkManagedAgentMutation) validates provider, model, account, workspace, credential, permission and transport values of a governed create or edit against the approved options read at the commit, with typed per-field refusals; standalone is unchanged and a managed host with no usable policy fails closed.
The agent repository asks the host authority with the record exactly as it would be committed, inside the command queue and before any write; a throwing authority is a refusal.

Renderer creation and editing (New Agent, Edit Agent, clone, wizard, worktree spawn and discovery, CLI create and duplicate, merge, transfer, Cue bundle import, Symphony) converge on sessions:commitAgent; whole-record setMany/setAll writes restore governed fields from the stored record.

The New Agent, Edit Agent and Symphony agent forms show the managed choices notice, send the policy revision they were shown, keep the draft on a refusal and recover from a stale revision; held provider settings render disabled with the reason.
A Symphony contribution commits its agent before any clone, fork or draft PR, and withdraws the admitted agent when the repository start fails.

contractMappings.remaining: Approved choices arrive as opaque references and the reference resolver is host-only (null on the desktop), so the forms cannot narrow their pickers and governed values are validated at the host commit; recorded under DESKTOP-LOCAL/1 (agentMutation, newAgentForm, editAgentForm, symphonyAgentCreation). No shipped wire operation or advertised capability was invented; production admission still requires authenticated negotiated authority.
